articles.title: [Interview] Ukraine’s former defence chief predicts new EU security alliance, gives behind-the-scenes look at Russia diplomacy
articles.description: What happens behind the scenes at peace talks with Russia and in negotiations with allies? Oleksii Reznikov, Ukrainian defence minister at the start of Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022, spoke candidly about his time leading his country's defence efforts. Now lecturing university students about negotiating tactics, he says Europe might soon see a new security alliance.

articles.title: Melania Trump hopes for new ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia by Christmas

articles.title: Strikes on Kerch Bridge can force Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations - Ukraine at OSCE
articles.description: The consequences of Russia's rejection of Ukraine's proposals for a ceasefire are now visible on the Kerch Bridge. Damage to the bridge could serve as a powerful reminder to the Kremlin of the need to reconsider its position and move towards constructive peace negotiations. — Ukrinform.
